第 43 章 How to Help Your New Grad Engineer Navigate Work如何帮新毕业工程师适应工作

Kaya Thomas / 卡娅·托马斯

— 第 129 页 —

I started my first full-time job less than a month after I graduated from college. I moved across the country from the East Coast to the Bay Area, feeling ready to join the work world and be a "real" adult. Those first six months were a tough transition that no one prepared me for. Now, a couple of years later, I realized that many managers are often far removed from the transition that most new grads experience in starting their first job. I didn't know at the time how to communicate my struggles. In this essay, I go over conversations that you can have with your new grad engineer that can help ease their transition and teach them techniques to navigate the work world.

我大学毕业后不到一个月就开始了第一份全职工作。我从东海岸搬到湾区，感觉准备好加入职场、做一个「真正的」成年人。那前六个月是艰难的转变，没人帮我准备。现在几年后，我意识到很多经理往往远离大多数新毕业生开始第一份工作时经历的转变。我当时不知道怎么沟通我的挣扎。在这篇文章中，我讲了你可以和新毕业工程师进行的对话，帮他们减轻转变的痛苦、教他们在职场航行的技巧。

The new grad joining your team has just accomplished a big long-term goal: graduating college. With that under their belt, what's the next goal that they need to work toward? For some, that new goal might be to become a CTO, vice president, or principal architect, but what are the steps they need to take to get there?

加入你团队的新毕业生刚完成了一个重大长期目标：大学毕业。有了这个，他们下一个需要努力的目标是什么？对有些人来说，新目标可能是成为 CTO、VP 或首席架构师，但他们需要采取什么步骤到达那里？

While in school, the steps to graduation are clear: take a certain set of classes, pass them, and you get a diploma. In the work world, things aren't usually as explicit. As a manager you can have the conversation that helps your new grad set realistic short-term and long-term goals. Ask them what type of impact they would like to have in their career and translate those into goals. The most important step is to break those larger goals into mini-goals. Smaller and short-term goals are less overwhelming and can be just as rewarding when it's clear how they relate to the larger goals you've set.

在学校时，到毕业的步骤很清楚：上一系列课，通过，拿到文凭。在职场，事情通常没那么明确。作为经理，你可以进行对话帮新毕业生设定现实的短期和长期目标。问他们想在职业生涯中产生什么类型的影响，把它们转化为目标。最重要的步骤是把大目标拆成小目标。更小、更短期的目标不那么令人不知所措，而且当清楚它们和你设的大目标有什么关系时，同样有回报。

— 第 130 页 —

One of the most difficult things for me to grasp during those first few months at work was that your efforts would not directly translate into acknowledgement or promotions. As a student, the amount of work you put in was directly rewarded through your grades and you were able to keep track of all that work with your transcripts. I soon realized that, at work, your manager would not always know everything that you're doing and what you've accomplished that day or week. My manager encouraged me to keep a personal record of all my accomplishments, big or small. Encourage your new grad engineer to have their own record of their work, which should include not only their technical successes, but also their achievements in collaboration and communication. Documenting their achievements will help them better be able to advocate for themselves rather than expecting someone to keep track of what they've done and advocate for them.

工作头几个月我最难理解的事情之一是，你的努力不会直接转化为认可或晋升。作为学生，你投入的工作量直接通过成绩得到回报，你可以用成绩单跟踪所有那些工作。我很快意识到，在工作中，你的经理不会总是知道你在做什么、你那天或那周完成了什么。我的经理鼓励我个人记录所有成就，无论大小。鼓励你的新毕业生记录自己的工作，不仅包括技术成功，还包括协作和沟通方面的成就。记录成就会帮他们更好地为自己发声，而不是期待别人跟踪他们做了什么并替他们发声。

After discussing goal setting and self-advocacy with your new grad, you can connect those to two topics to go over promotions and career growth. No matter what kind of career ladder or promotion cycle your company has, you can break it down in a similar way as the goal setting conversation. Which of the goals they've already set match to how they can grow in their current role? Which accomplishments did they write down in their record that they can use to show they are performing at the next level? These questions are a great way to make career growth seem more approachable because it relates back to previous techniques you've gone over. It's difficult to jump from being a student with a clear goal and end date in mind, to a full-time professional with decades of work life ahead of them with unclear expectations. These conversations can make a big difference in easing the stress of the transition and help prepare them for having a clear path to achieve in their career.

和新毕业生讨论完目标设定和自我倡导后，你可以把它们和晋升与职业发展两个话题联系起来。不管你的公司有什么样的职业阶梯或晋升周期，你可以用和目标设定对话类似的方式拆解。他们已经设的目标中哪些和他们在当前角色中的成长匹配？他们记录里写的哪些成就可以用来展示他们在按更高层级表现？这些问题是让职业发展看起来更亲切的好方式，因为它和你之前讲的技巧联系起来。从一个有明确目标和结束日期的学生，跳到一个有几十年工作生涯、期望不明确的全职专业人士，是很难的。这些对话可以大大减轻转变压力，帮他们准备好有一条清晰的职业道路。
